card.title: PS4 BLOD Diagnosis and APU/RAM Issues

claims.statement: A 6-second pulsing blue light or solid blue light often indicates a faulty Southbridge or missing +3.3V standby rail.
claims.quote: 6 second BLOD it will pulsing blue light for 6 seconds or it will stay a solid blue light for indefinitely period Missing +3.3Vstby power rail – could be shorted or southbridge is bad

claims.statement: PS4 1200 series consoles are prone to RAM issues; inspect for burn marks or overheating.
claims.quote: PS4 1200 series are know to have RAM problems. If you get the 1200 series check the physical state of the RAM IC, look for burn marks.

procedure: Disconnect hard drive to test if console enters safe mode.
Apply pressure to APU clamp to test for BGA connection issues.
Check RAM modules for overheating using thermal camera or alcohol.
card.caveats: BLOD is a generic symptom and can be caused by multiple subsystems including PSU, APU, RAM, or Southbridge.
